sloka: तौ हत्वा जनभोगार्थं कैटभं तु मधुं तथा ।अनेन शरमुख्येन ततो लोकांश्चकार सः ।। ७.६३.२३ ॥
transliteration: tau hatvā janabhogārthaṁ kaiṭabhaṁ tu madhuṁ tathā ।anena śaramukhyena tato lokāṁścakāra saḥ ।। 7.63.23 ॥

translations.english: Having killed Kaitabha and Madhu for the benefit of mankind, he (Vishnu) then created the worlds with this excellent arrow.
translations.hindi: वे कई बार अनेक राजवंशों की स्थापना करेंगे । उनसे सीता के दो पुत्र होंगे
